meta.title: Visual Asset Browser
meta.subtitle: Curated sources for 3D models, textures, HDRIs, characters, animations and 2D game art — with thumbnails for quick visual browsing.

items.name: Poly Pizza
items.desc: Thousands of free CC0 3D models, searchable by category with one-click glTF/GLB downloads.

items.name: Kenney
items.desc: The indie gold standard — 40k+ CC0 models, UI packs, textures, fonts and audio for every genre.

items.name: Quaternius
items.desc: Ultimate low-poly pack library — animals, vehicles, buildings, characters, many pre-animated.

items.name: Poly Haven — Models
items.desc: Small but gorgeous CC0 model library — plants, props, rocks and studio sets.

items.name: Khronos glTF Sample Models
items.desc: The official reference glTF models — perfect for testing loaders, PBR, skinning and animation.

items.name: ambientCG
items.desc: 10,000+ CC0 PBR texture sets — albedo, normal, roughness, metalness at every resolution.

items.name: Poly Haven — Textures
items.desc: Beautiful CC0 PBR textures with physically-based maps and multiple resolutions.

items.name: Poly Haven — HDRIs
items.desc: Free CC0 HDRIs for environment lighting and reflections — the standard source.

items.name: 3DTextures.me
items.desc: Large free PBR texture library with all maps included for each material.

items.name: textures.com
items.desc: Massive commercial texture library — free account earns daily credits.

items.name: Mixamo
items.desc: Adobe's free auto-rigged characters and 2,500+ animations with FBX/glTF export.

items.name: Ready Player Me
items.desc: Cross-game avatar creator — build and export GLB avatars for your Three.js game.

items.name: Rokoko Free Mocap
items.desc: Thousands of free motion-capture clips for animating characters — great for testing rigs.

items.name: glTF Avatar Samples
items.desc: Official Khronos sample assets incl. rigged, skinned characters for animation testing.

items.name: game-icons.net
items.desc: 4,000+ free game icons (CC BY 3.0) as SVG/PNG — perfect for UI, pickups and abilities.

items.name: CraftPix
items.desc: Game art marketplace — sprites, tilesets, UI kits; free packs released weekly.

items.name: OpenGameArt — 2D
items.desc: Huge community library of sprites, tilesets, characters and icons — filter by license.

items.name: itch.io — Free Assets
items.desc: Thousands of free asset packs from indie artists — models, sprites, VFX, UI.

items.name: Blockbench
items.desc: Free low-poly/voxel modeling tool — Minecraft-style models, animation, glTF/OBJ export.

items.name: MagicaVoxel
items.desc: The legendary free voxel editor — sculpt voxel scenes and export OBJ/PLY to Three.js.

items.name: Sketchfab
items.desc: The biggest 3D model marketplace — huge free CC section with glTF/GLB downloads.

items.name: FAB (Epic)
items.desc: Epic's cross-engine marketplace (Quixel + Sketchfab) — large free CC0 tier.

items.name: TurboSquid
items.desc: Massive commercial marketplace with a dedicated free 3D models section.

items.name: CGTrader
items.desc: Big marketplace — filter by free, thousands of royalty-free models.

items.name: OpenGameArt — All
items.desc: Community hub for free game art — 3D models, sprites, textures, sounds and music.

items.name: Blender
items.desc: Free 3D suite with first-class glTF export — the standard companion to Three.js.

items.name: Spline
items.desc: Browser 3D design tool with a Three.js runtime — fast for UI scenes and interactive objects.
